strategy_description: Long SPY when lagged petroleum inventory signal is above threshold; otherwise cash.
lead_description: L0 monthly is feasible under Dana's release-lag convention; daily LVCF uses only public carried-forward values.

selection.rationale: Unique maximiser of OOS Sharpe over the committed coarse monthly grid L{0,1,2,3,6,12} (5,123 valid combos, median OOS Sharpe 0.7866). Winner raw OOS Sharpe 1.4779 at L12; the 2nd-best valid combo (petrol_level_z60/T2_roll_p25/P1_long_cash_pro/L3) sits at 1.4539. No ECON-T3 tie-break engaged (unique max on oos_sharpe). Published winner == raw max-OOS-Sharpe valid row -> divergence null.

notes: Mode-3 Codex maker. Tournament: 7392 strategy rows plus one benchmark valid=False; 5123 valid. Winner selected by ECON-T3 at step 1; 1 tied at Sharpe step. Bootstrap p=0.099; CP1 durability=conditionally_durable; rolling correlation=moderately_stable. Petroleum inventories are coincident physical stocks, so reverse-causality evidence is reported rather than suppressed.
